subject: Recompete: Cloud Spend Platform — scoring matrix and SOW timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@pennylanefinops.com>, sales@pennylanefinops.com
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Recompete for cloud spend platform

Hi Sara / PennyLane team —

We’re starting a formal recompete for our cloud cost management + FinOps orchestration tooling ahead of the renewal with our current vendor in Q3. Acme Retail (one of our major customers) has requested tighter unit-cost reporting and automated allocation that we need supported in the SOW.

Request: please send an updated RFP response that includes
- itemized unit pricing (ingest/analysis/retention tiers)
- SLA options and response times for infra incidents
- migration support and sample SOW templates
- a short migration runbook and estimated effort (FTE days)

Target timeline: initial responses by 2026-06-30 so we can complete internal scoring the first week of July.

Attached: recompete-requirements.pdf (features + evaluation criteria).

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer GTM, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Sara Lopez <sara@pennylanefinops.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Recompete for cloud spend platform

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the brief. We can absolutely respond by 06/30. A few quick clarifying questions so our RFP is scoped correctly:
1) For unit pricing, do you want historical tokenized compute breakdowns (per-inference) or purely infra-level (VM/GPU hours)?
2) Is the migration window constrained to business hours for Acme, or do you allow a weekend cutover?
3) Any mandatory compliance artifacts beyond SOC 2 (e.g., UK Cyber Essentials for their EU customers)?

We’ve attached a first-pass response (PennyLane_RFP_response_v1.pdf) and a short timeline that hits your target. We’ve also included two optional add-ons (automated tagging policy enforcement, cross-account chargeback connector).

Attachment: PennyLane_RFP_response_v1.pdf

—Sara
Sara Lopez
Head of Sales Engineering, PennyLane FinOps
sara@pennylanefinops.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Recompete for cloud spend platform

Marissa / team —

Thanks, Sara — looks good for timing. Internal ask: I want a one-sheet scoring matrix (weights + pass/fail) to compare PennyLane, current incumbent, and CloudLedger (three vendors). I’ve started a template — scoring-template.xlsx — with weighted rows (cost, feature coverage, SLA, implementation effort, security/compliance).

Can each of you take an ownerable section:
- Ben: run the infra-level cost delta (estimate monthly delta on our sample 200k monthly tokens workload)
- Karthik: security and compliance assessment (SOC2 + optional artifacts)
- Marissa: commercial terms and go-to-customer impacts (migration effort, SOW assumptions)

Please add your notes to the shared Drive link and flag any blockers by Thursday EOD. I’ll consolidate and produce the shortlist + recommended SOW terms for legal.

Link: https://drive.google.com/scoresheet/1aBcdExampleScoring

Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Recompete for cloud spend platform

On Thu, Jun 25, 2026 at 15:22, Ben Carter wrote:
> Hannah — I’ll run the infra-level cost tests next week against the sample workload and post numbers in the scoring sheet.
> Also confirming I’ll include a brief sensitivity chart (spot vs. reserved GPU assumptions).

Short note: I started populating the cost tab; current incumbent looks competitive on license but PennyLane’s tagging automation reduces OPEX drift materially — will quantify by Monday.

—Ben

Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Shortlist and delta summary — recommend PennyLane for PO-friendly SOW

Team —

I reviewed the responses and filled the security/compliance tab in scoring-template.xlsx. High level:
- Incumbent: SOC 2 Type II in place, limited cross-account chargeback features, lower retention controls.
- CloudLedger: strong analytics but missing enforced tagging and higher migration effort (3-4 FTE weeks).
- PennyLane: matches SOC 2, provided encryption KMS options, and their optional add-on covers cross-account chargeback.

Cost delta (monthly, estimated): Incumbent -> PennyLane = +$12k/month on list pricing, but expected ~6-9% savings from automated tag enforcement and chargeback recoveries over 6 months. See attached shortlist-summary.pdf.

Recommendation: shortlist PennyLane to negotiate an enterprise SOW with a performance credit SLA and a phased migration (pilot -> rollout). If legal signs off, request PennyLane’s SOW draft and finalize commercial adjustments (term, termination, data residency).

I’ll get a concise SOW redline list ready for Legal if you approve moving to SOW negotiation.

—Karthik
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@pennylanefinops.com>, sales@pennylanefinops.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme-retail.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Approval to proceed to SOW negotiation — PennyLane shortlist

Sara —

Thanks for the rapid response and for the materials. Internal consensus is to move PennyLane forward as the preferred vendor for the upcoming renewal. Please do the following:
1) Share a draft SOW scoped for a phased pilot (30 days) then rollout (90 days ramp) that includes:
   - itemized pricing (pilot vs. production)
   - performance credit SLA (latency & data pipeline availability)
   - clear migration milestones and acceptance criteria
   - optional chargeback connector as an add-on line item
2) Provide a DocuSign-ready SOW by 2026-07-09 so Redwood Legal can review and start redlines.

We’ll expect a standard 60-day net payment term unless you propose otherwise. I’m copying Acme procurement so they can align resident policies.

Links: SOW draft template attached (SOW-draft-PL-2026-07.docx) and DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/abc123-SOW

Looking forward — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Attachments: SOW-draft-PL-2026-07.docx
